summaries.construction: 95% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 5% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 18%, MSFTx 16.44%, AAPLx 15.75%.
summaries.benchmark: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.42% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.26%.
summaries.rebalance: Rebalance only when drift clears 300 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.3% annualized turnover, 12.07 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 95% turnover and 43.25 bps total costs with 5% parked in AUSD.
summaries.realityCheck: Authoritative scoring now uses 300 bps drift bands and implies 3.3% annualized turnover across 1 rebalance events; legacy static proxy remains available for comparison.
summaries.operator: Starter Breadth Trim keeps 95% in xStocks across 6 starter basket only names anchored to Mag 7, with 5% in AUSD. Top sleeves: NVDAx 18%, MSFTx 16.44%, AAPLx 15.75%. Change from slot baseline: Breadth: 7 names -> 6 names. After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.42% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.26%.
